scope: 第六篇 Engine 调度修复及上下文优化；包含工作区已有改动，非全仓验收

pytest.command:
audit_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/deepseek-e06-final.XXXXXX)
DEEPSEEK_HOME="$audit_root" CLAUDE_PLUGINS_DIR="$audit_root/plugins" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/engine tests/test_usage_ledger.py tests/test_usage_token_semantics.py tests/test_live_session_activity.py tests/test_session_activity_integration.py tests/test_workbench_usage_ledger.py tests/test_session_model_usage.py tests/test_subagent_*.py tests/test_durable_resume.py tests/test_task_stop_cleanup.py tests/test_audit_regressions.py tests/test_project_context_merge.py tests/test_context_window_defaults.py tests/test_context_meter_live.py tests/contract/test_context_breakdown.py tests/contract/test_cycle_archive_is_reachable.py tests/contract/test_cycle_briefing_fidelity.py tests/contract/test_reminder_registry.py tests/contract/test_compact_thread.py tests/contract/test_turn_approval_integration.py --deselect='tests/test_subagent_stage_a_fixes.py::test_hidden_internal_turn_carries_its_own_provenance[goal_continuation]' -q --tb=short
pytest.skip_reason: 三项 live API 测试未显式启用；未调用真实模型
pytest.deselect_reason: 既有 Goal 隐藏续跑契约差异：无活跃 Goal 时是否继续执行，本轮未修改 Goal 行为

checks.ruff: 主要修改文件 F 类检查通过；context.py 原有 re 未使用/重复导入未清理，非全仓 lint 通过

benchmarks.limitations: 离线固定负载；并行指标是结果可见延迟，非吞吐。裁剪哈希比较使用普通用户消息，合成提醒的语义变化由回归测试单独验证。

historical_probes: engine_probe.py、context_probe.py 及 before 结果保留为修复前反例；当前正确性由正向 pytest 验证。
